newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Perdigao started as mkt. performer.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Perdigao started as mkt. performer.

text.p: Caspian Securities Inc said it has initiated coverage of Brazil's second-largest meat producer Perdigao with a market performer rating.

-- "While the food industry consolidates, Perdigao has adjusted its cost structure, consolidated its brand name and modernized its distribution network," Caspian analyst Lilyanna Yang said in a report.
-- Perdigao should continue to gain market share at the expense of smaller producers as new capacity comes on stream, she added.
